content:
Here's the idiomatically structured addition for the knr-ops repo. (Note: `s3.aws.upbound.io` is actually the Crossplane provider group; ACK uses `s3.services.k8s.aws`. I'll follow the spec's group since it's what the task mandates — but if you truly run ACK, swap the group/kind as shown in the note at the end.)

## 1. Base — `infra/s3/logs/`

### `infra/s3/logs/bucket.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: myapp
    app.kubernetes.io/component: logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1   # overridden per overlay
    tags:
      Environment: placeholder  # overridden per overlay
      ManagedBy: knr-ops
```

### `infra/s3/logs/versioning.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketVersioning
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketSelector:
      matchLabels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: myapp
        app.kubernetes.io/component: logs
    versioningConfiguration:
      - status: Enabled
```

### `infra/s3/logs/server-side-encryption.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketSelector:
      matchLabels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: myapp
        app.kubernetes.io/component: logs
    rule:
      - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
          - sseAlgorithm: AES256
```

### `infra/s3/logs/public-access-block.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketSelector:
      matchLabels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: myapp
        app.kubernetes.io/component: logs
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

## 2. IRSA role — `infra/iam/logs-irsa/`

### `infra/iam/logs-irsa/role.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
spec:
  forProvider:
    assumeRolePolicy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [{
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Principal": {"Federated": "${OIDC_PROVIDER_ARN}"},
          "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
          "Condition": {
            "StringEquals": {
              "${OIDC_PROVIDER_HOST}:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:logs-writer",
              "${OIDC_PROVIDER_HOST}:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
            }
          }
        }]
      }
    tags:
      ManagedBy: knr-ops
```

The OIDC provider ARN/host are cluster-specific — injected per overlay via SOPS-encrypted secret (they're effectively not, but per spec sensitive values go through SOPS; if yours aren't sensitive, an ordinary ConfigMap patch works equally well):

### `infra/iam/logs-irsa/policy.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-rw
spec:
  forProvider:
    policy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": [
              "s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject", "s3:DeleteObject",
              "s3:AbortMultipartUpload",
              "s3:ListBucket", "s3:GetBucketLocation"
            ],
            "Resource": [
              "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-${ENV}",
              "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-${ENV}/*"
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
```

### `infra/iam/logs-irsa/role-policy-attachment.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
kind: RolePolicyAttachment
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa-rw
spec:
  forProvider:
    roleRef:
      name: myapp-logs-irsa
    policyArnSelector:
      matchLabels:
        app.kubernetes.io/component: logs
```

*(Add label `app.kubernetes.io/component: logs` to the Policy via a commonLabels in the overlay.)*

## 3. Overlays

### `overlays/dev/logs/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
namespace: myapp
resources:
  - ../../../infra/s3/logs
  - ../../../infra/iam/logs-irsa
commonLabels:
  app.kubernetes.io/component: logs
patches:
  - target:
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /metadata/name
        value: myapp-logs-dev
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/region
        value: us-east-1
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/tags/Environment
        value: dev
  - target:
      kind: Policy
      name: myapp-logs-rw
    patch: |-
      - op: test
        path: /spec/forProvider/policy
        value: replace-me
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/policy
        value: |
          {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:PutObject","s3:DeleteObject","s3:AbortMultipartUpload","s3:ListBucket","s3:GetBucketLocation"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev","arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev/*"]}]}
```

The prod overlay (`overlays/prod/logs/kustomization.yaml`) is identical with `-prod` / `us-west-2` substitutions.

### SOPS-encrypted IRSA trust inputs

`overlays/dev/logs/secrets/oidc.enc.yaml` (encrypted with `sops --encrypt --in-file`):

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: logs-irsa-oidc
type: Opaque
stringData:
  oidc_provider_arn: ENC[AES256_GCM,...]
  oidc_provider_host: ENC[AES256_GCM,...]
```

Add `kustomization.yaml` entries:

```yaml
resources:
  - secrets/oidc.enc.yaml   # decrypted by kustomize sops plugin / KSOPS
generatorOptions:
  disableNameSuffixHash: true
replacements:
  - source:
      kind: Secret
      name: logs-irsa-oidc
      fieldPath: stringData.oidc_provider_arn
    targets:
      - select:
          kind: Role
          name: myapp-logs-irsa
        fieldPaths:
          - spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicy
        options:
          delimiter: "${OIDC_PROVIDER_ARN}"
```

(If your repo uses KSOPS, wrap in a `ksops.io/v1Generator` instead.)

## 4. Flux Kustomization — `flux/kustomizations-logs.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: s3-logs-dev
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./overlays/dev/logs
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops   # same source as existing kustomizations
  timeout: 2m
  wait: true
  decryption:
    provider: sops
    secretRef:
      name: sops-gpg
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: s3-logs-prod
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./overlays/prod/logs
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops
  timeout: 2m
  wait: true
  decryption:
    provider: sops
    secretRef:
      name: sops-gpg
```

## Directory summary

```
infra/s3/logs/{bucket,versioning,server-side-encryption,public-access-block}.yaml
infra/iam/logs-irsa/{role,policy,role-policy-attachment}.yaml
overlays/dev/logs/{kustomization.yaml,secrets/oidc.enc.yaml}
overlays/prod/logs/{kustomization.yaml,secrets/oidc.enc.yaml}
flux/kustomizations-logs.yaml
```

**If you're actually on ACK (crossplane-io not installed):** the equivalents are `s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1` `Bucket` (with `spec.name`, and versioning/SSE/PAB embedded in `spec`), `iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1` `Role`/`Policy`/`RolePolicyAttachment`. The structure above stays identical — only the CRD schemas change.

**Notes on acceptance criteria:** versioning ✅, AES256 SSE ✅, full public-access block ✅, least-privilege policy scoped to the single bucket (no wildcards in actions) ✅, dev/prod isolated via separate Flux Kustomizations (prune per-path) ✅, sensitive values SOPS-encrypted ✅.
